newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury's five-yr note yield seen at 6.41 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury's five-yr note yield seen at 6.41 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's auction of $12.5 billion in five-year notes on Thursday is expected to produce a yield near 6.41 percent, dealers said.

"There's general optimism but also a little anxiety that the market has gotten ahead of itself," said Josh Stiles, senior bond strategist at I.D.E.A. "You don't want to go buy five-years at levels close to where other people are ready to take profits."
At 1255 EDT/1655 GMT, the five-year notes were quoted at 6.4125 percent in when-issued trade.
The bidding deadline for the notes is 1300 EDT/1700 GMT and results are expected around 1345 EDT/1745 GMT.
